prompt: Review this change before it merges. The change is the last three commits of this checkout. Get the diff with `git diff 3baf3ff7b86bafbac5cca511215c2c38e6e77b45 HEAD`. It adds scripts/release-summary.sh, which sends the pull requests of a release to a model, checks the model's summary and writes it into the GitHub release notes. Review only this checkout at HEAD. Do not build or run tests. Reply with the full review report.

expected.text: The link check in scripts/release-summary.sh only finds links that start with lower-case http:// or https://. A link in another form passes and can point outside the repository: a protocol-relative //host link, a www. link, an upper-case scheme, or a repository link that uses /../ to leave the repository. Any one of these counts.
Pull request text is put inside a <release> tag in the prompt without escaping <, so a PR title or body that holds the closing tag ends the data block early and the rest is read as instructions.
The first heading text is written twice: once as FIRST_HEADING and again as a literal in ALLOWED_HEADINGS.
The tests do not cover some paths: a second pull request body, the curl arguments, the attested binary path, or a failed attestation of the notes.
